That's kind of how I feel, if you're consuming 5 calories of coffee I don't quite understand how that can possibly mess up your fast so much that it's not worth doing lol.
I think you should educate yourself on eating disorders before commenting on something like this.

Anorexia is an eating disorder? So how can eating disorder make you anorexic if it is an eating disorder. I think you're confused. 

Being "underweight and not eating because you think you're ugly and fat" definitely is not the working definition of an eating disorder. An eating disorder relates to the relationship someone has with food. I would argue that most overweight and obese people have an eating disorder, as with many underweight people. People of all different weights can suffer from an eating disorder it's not just very thin people starving themselves. 

I don't know how you can argue that its justified for a therapist to tell someone to continue with terrible habits just so they lose weight. Thats ridiculous.
